title: Cortex Execution Event
description: Schema for structured execution events logged by codex-exec-wrapper.sh. Each event is one line in a JSONL log file.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event occurred

file_path.description: For file_edited events: path of the edited file

test_command.description: For test_run events: the test command executed

test_passed.description: For test_run events: whether the test passed

exit_code.description: For task_completed/task_failed events: process exit code

fallback_reason.description: For task_failed events: reason for failure (timeout, crash, test_failure, etc.)

step_count.description: For task_completed/task_failed events: number of steps taken

max_steps.description: For budget_exceeded events: the budget that was exceeded

consecutive_failures.description: For circuit_breaker events: number of consecutive failures

tokens.description: Token usage for this event (if applicable)

cost_usd.description: Cost in USD for this event (if applicable)
